vp1102a.title: Sailor Shikiori Otogibanashi Orihime Fountain Pen 14K Gold Nib MF 11-1227-302
vp1102a.packing: Carefully packed with protective cushioning and shipped from Japan with tracking.
vp1102a.details: Sailor Shikiori Otogibanashi series fountain pen, Orihime (the Weaver Princess), model 11-1227-302. The navy resin body is filled with fine glitter, like the night sky of the Tanabata story, and has gold-plated trim. It has a 14K gold nib in Medium Fine (MF) with gold plating, and takes both cartridges and a converter. The barrel is 17 mm in diameter and 124 mm long, and the pen weighs 16.8 g. Condition: brand new and unused. The photos are product images. Please see the photos for the pen.
